description: AAC Main (ADTS profile 0), mono: long windows with prediction and a TNS filter of order 12, 13, 20 and 31 over 30 bands: Main allows an order of 20, so the filters of 13 and 20 decode as coded and the one of 31 takes its first 20 coefficients.
findings: a TNS filter of a higher order than the 20 its window allows
